title: Democrats win US House in growing midterms wave against Trump

blocks.text: WASHINGTON — Democrats won the House and were within reach of taking over the Senate in a rapidly building midterms wave Tuesday projected to sweep Republicans aside and deliver a stinging repudiation of Donald Trump’s bruising presidency. CNN and CNBC projected a Democratic House majority, giving the opposition the power to block Trump’s legislative agenda
